requested_outcome: Every visible place feature and amenity on every VII detail-page world has a clear, centered semantic icon, including values not explicitly known in advance, and the verified change is published without regressing existing detail-page behavior.
natural_destination: Public VII place pages at https://vii.spaplus.co
authorization_boundary: Source changes, tests, production publication and post-deploy verification are explicitly authorized. No supplier-data edits, DNS changes, purchases or unrelated redesign are authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared visual defect must be repaired and verified across the full place-page family at the public destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require desktop and mobile public evidence for vacation, events, spa and hourly detail pages, plus automated family guards.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested result includes publication to the shared production destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Build from the current production baseline, retain rollback identity, publish once and verify the exact deployed version.

lesson_bundle.reason: The phrase every feature means the complete component family, not the single visible vacation example.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory all detail-page worlds and provide a deterministic fallback for future supplier labels.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the specific vacation page is fixed while event, spa or hourly features remain generic or iconless.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one shared semantic feature-icon component in all four detail-page families.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Source and live-page checks cover vacation, event, spa and hourly detail pages.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Plural Hebrew words containing the letters ים are incorrectly classified as sea or view features.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use ordered, phrase-aware matching and test חדרי שינה, אורחים and אחסון explicitly.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Classifier tests return bed, users and storage icons rather than view.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Known labels get icons but a new API label renders without one.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Return a consistent semantic fallback icon for every non-empty label.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Unknown labels render the fallback vector inside the same centered wrapper.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The icon exists in the DOM but is clipped, off-center or visually inconsistent on mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve the normalized icon wrappers and add shared SVG centering rules for every new consumer.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and 390-pixel screenshots show centered icons with no overflow.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A new deployment overwrites unrelated fixes from the current public version.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the current release worktree, run the full regression suite and verify representative unchanged flows after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Build, full tests and live detail routes pass on the exact deployed version with a recorded rollback.

affected_family: vacation business highlights and grouped amenities
vacation room and sleeping amenity rows
Hebrew, English, Russian and French labels

sources.label: All centered SVG feature icons use their own normalized wrapper
Existing vacation feature-card layout and visual treatment

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the shared classifier and vacation/event consumers are implemented
checks: Verify representative Hebrew labels map to the intended semantic icons
Verify the shared component preserves existing wrappers and centered SVG geometry before expanding to spa and hourly

attack_questions: Does any feature row in any detail-page world still render plain text without an icon?
Does any common Hebrew plural get an unrelated sea or view icon?
Does an unknown label disappear or render an empty wrapper?
Are icons centered and readable on desktop and 390-pixel mobile?
Did the deployment preserve galleries, booking, breadcrumbs, contact actions and feature expansion?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public version and screenshots or live DOM observations for representative vacation, event, spa and hourly detail routes after deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated tests, source inventory and live public checks covering every shared consumer and fallback behavior.

effectiveness.baseline: The public vacation page shows a mix of semantic icons and generic checkmarks, event pages use only checkmarks, hourly pages use one generic symbol and spa facilities have no icon wrapper.
effectiveness.target: One shared icon resolver removes iconless and misclassified features across all detail-page worlds in one release.
